summary: Phase 3 Wave Grid Enhancements - All features tested and working correctly

issues: Console warnings about chart dimensions (-1 width/height) - minor visual issue

critical_code_review_comments: HTML hydration warnings in console: <span> cannot be child of <tbody>/<tr> - caused by React rendering wrapper spans in table elements. Not blocking but should be addressed for cleaner DOM.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 wave grid enhancements fully tested. All features working: wave exclude toggle, floating add row button, sticky columns, split range dialog, payment milestones target month.

wave_exclude_toggle.details: Toggle found with data-testid='wave-exclude-toggle-{waveId}'. Clicking changes text from 'Exclude' to 'Excluded from Summary' (red). Overall summary values update correctly when wave is excluded.

floating_add_row_button.details: Button found with data-testid='floating-add-row-btn'. Text: 'Add Resource Row'. Visible when grid has rows.

sticky_columns.details: Found 36 sticky cells in the resource grid. First 6 columns (Skill, Level, Location, $/Month, Onsite, Travel) are sticky with position:sticky CSS.

split_range_dialog.details: Dialog opens when clicking calculator button (data-testid='apply-all-{id}'). Contains input field (data-testid='split-range-input') with placeholder 'e.g., 1 or M1-M3:1, M4-M5:0.5, M6:0'. Apply and Cancel buttons present.

payment_milestones_target_month.details: Target Month column present in milestone table. Position column removed. Target Month select (data-testid='ms-month-{id}') found. Linked Phase dropdown available.

resource_filtering_by_technology.details: Code review confirms filteredRates filters by project's selected technologies in WaveContent.js lines 67-74.

exclude_from_summary_persistence.details: Code review confirms exclude_from_summary field is saved with wave data. calculateOverallSummary in estimatorCalcs.js line 173 skips excluded waves.
